shared_elements: frontal standing human figure carved on an upright monolithic slab/stela
large headdress or head covering framing the face
face with prominent eyes and nose rendered frontally
belt or horizontal band across the waist/abdomen
low-relief carving filling the whole vertical field
justification: Both depict a single frontal standing human personage occupying an entire tall upright slab, with a broad head covering above the face, a disc-like ornament on the chest and a banded belt at the waist, which is a reasonably specific shared scheme. They differ greatly in execution: A is densely ornate with intricate interlaced regalia, held objects, glyph-like panels and subsidiary crouching figures at the base, whereas B is austere and schematic with a few shallow rounded motifs and no attendant figures or held attributes.
